scope: Retrospective external source check after E8/E8b numeric results; no new physical-acceptance threshold, raw data, fit, mocked observables or changed original E8 parents

source_paper.title: Dynamical friction in the primordial neutrino sea
source_paper.journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society 468 (2017), 2164–2175
source_paper.published_exact_equation: Published article Eq.(20), first equality, static halo longitudinal g_nu,k/Phi_k includes exact FD 1/(exp(q_res)+1).
source_paper.published_approximation: The same printed article's Eq.(20), second approximate equality, calls mu in [0.7,1), then uses mu=1 in later modeling Eq.(33) and Appendix A.
source_paper.unresolved_convention: As printed, mu in [0.7,1) cannot equal bare FD occupation 1/(exp(q)+1), which is <= 1/2 for q>=0. It may involve a separate normalization or published inconsistency; do NOT silently infer factor two or transfer the mu=1 forecast calibration to exact-denominator E8b.

physics.exact_E8b_branch: K_s=(2 N G m_nu^4 v_parallel)/(hbar^3 k_phys) F_s(q_res)/F_Class_prefactor, with FD branch F_FD=1/(exp(q_res)+1), N=1; same Phi,v,k for all; first equality of published Eq.(20)
physics.mode_response_definition: alpha_s=(g_nu,k/Phi_k)_s/k_phys, dimensionless conditional Fourier longitudinal field-to-original-gradient ratio at fixed halo Phi. The ratio of g_nu to -i k_phys Phi is imaginary, modulo the stated Fourier/sign convention. alpha is not dphi/dt, redshift-space xi or sample-averaged wake.
physics.comoving_formula_under_same_physical_sta: For k_com=a*k_phys and a=1/(1+z), alpha_s=2 N G m_nu^4 a^2 v_parallel F_s(q_res)/(hbar^3 k_com^2), with F_s the occupation without CLASS phase-space prefactor. This matches published Eq.(33)'s algebraic a^2/k_com^2 structure only if its mu symbol is consistently identified with exact occupation; its printed mu normalization remains unresolved.
physics.k_convention: k_phys=k_com/a=(1+z)k_com, do not re-label same numerical h/Mpc value without conversion
